rationale: The candidate spans multiple UX lines, six canonical owners, eight source and eight derived paths, and affects product semantics and runtime. Compact Delivery is ineligible because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not supplied; deterministic propagation is also absent. The breadth and cross-owner impact support structured_delivery as the non-authorizing eventual path candidate.
